title: Report 08: can you get your data out of a SaaS tool?
population: Business software tools we tested hands-on in our own accounts and ran an exit test on: 111 tools, 2026-10-23 to 2026-11-12.
selection: Not a sample of the market: tools from our review corpus that we tested hands-on with a free plan or trial, on the plan that test used. Each tool counts once, with its most recent exit test.

headline.text: tools that gave us an export file of the data we put in

metrics.label: tools with no self-serve export of the test data
tools where export needed a higher plan
obtained files we opened and checked
obtained files with a concrete quirk in the file itself
obtained files where some test data was missing or changed
re-imports without duplicates or altered data

limitations: Not a random sample: tools we review and could test ourselves, mostly for small and mid-sized businesses.
One account per tool, on the plan the test used (often a trial); a higher plan can export more.
We export only the synthetic records we put in during the test, not a full account backup.
Each verdict is coded from the published test record and links to it; friction is described, not scored.
next_full_recheck: with every new exit test (new edition)
